notes: Compressor-cooled dynamic climate chamber, standard article 9020-0376 (400 V). Outer box 1,115 x 1,710 x 925 mm (W x H x D), net weight 321 kg. Interior 735 x 700 x 443 mm, 228 L, stainless steel, 1 rack std / 6 max, 30 kg per rack, 70 kg permitted load. Rates: heating 5.0 K/min, cooling 4.5 K/min (IEC 60068-3-5), 180 C to -40 C in 110 min. Refrigerant R-452A. Single front door with heated viewing window and LED interior lighting; door heating. The only pass-through in the standard configuration is a 50 mm access port with silicone plug on the left wall (wiring entry 'none' means no fixed looms; user cables pass through the plugged port). APT.line preheating chamber technology (forced air circulation implied but fan speed not published). Wall clearances 300 mm back, 200 mm sides. Energy 1,300 Wh/h at 20 C.
